summary_for_children: Surah Qaf points to the sky with no cracks, the earth with mountains and plants, and rain that brings life, as signs that Allah can bring people back to life.
environment_concept: A sky without rifts (50:6), mountains and beautiful plants (50:7), blessed rain over grain (50:9) and lofty palms with layered fruit (50:10).
architecture_and_scenery: A seamless dome sky, wide plains, firm mountains, harvest fields, tall palm groves.

activities.name: Find a rift
activities.description: Search the sky for any crack and discover none (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Harvest
activities.description: Plant three seeds of grain; the rain makes them grow.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration links revived land to resurrection (50:11).
learning_objectives: Explain that Allah knows our thoughts

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (cloud, horizon, mountain, orchard, palms) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A dry valley under a wide clear sky, ringed by firm hills, with tall date palms by a spring and a garden shed of glass-sided growing boxes

primary_mechanic.text: Sow three seeds (sesame, wheat, broad bean) each at its own depth in glass-sided boxes (too shallow or too deep is refused with the reason), then water and wait three days, watching roots go down and shoots come up out of dry earth (50:9-11).

secondary_activities: closer than the jugular vein (50:16-18, read)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading on the path, three days at the growing boxes, then readings by the palms
environment_behaviour: roots grow down and shoots come up through the glass, day by day
unique_world.learning_objective: See how rain gives life to dead land (50:9-11) and that this is a sign of the coming forth

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Earth Comes Alive
story_library.children_narration: Look at the sky, mountains, trees, and fields. The Quran asks us to think about the beauty and order of creation. Rain falls, and plants grow from land that was dry. These signs invite us to reflect on life, resurrection, and our responsibility for our choices.

world_idea.title: The Garden After Rain
world_idea.description: Explore an arid landscape that gradually grows plants after rainfall. Observe seed germination and discover Quran-linked reflection points.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
